quote_lock: GBNF grammar from look.py --gbnf; pins the verbatim payload, frees one trailing sentence

detector.heuristics: disabled (raw network output; extraction is done by look.py)

raw.container: jpeg (also png, gif, webp, bmp tails)

selection: AI42 marker > container field (exif, raw) > bare pixel stream; ties prefer the detector's predicted method
bare_stream_filter: null terminator, strict UTF-8, printable, >=4 chars, >=3 distinct, letters+spaces >= 60%
